_about: Room-temperature (300 K) bulk properties commonly quoted in textbooks and reviews. Values vary with doping, crystal quality and polytype; treat them as representative, not as specifications. mu_* in cm^2/(V s); Ec (critical/breakdown field) in MV/cm; k (thermal conductivity) in W/(cm K); vsat in 1e7 cm/s; eps_r relative permittivity. For 2D and 1D materials, bulk-style 'Ec' and 'k' are not well defined and are left null.

materials.name: Germanium
materials.status: First transistor material; SiGe/Ge now used in pFET channels and HBTs
materials.logic_role: Point-contact & alloy-junction transistors (1947-1960s); SiGe stressors and channels today

materials.name: Silicon
materials.logic_role: CMOS logic from 10 µm to 2 nm-class GAA; native SiO2 made the MOSFET possible

materials.name: Gallium arsenide
materials.status: RF front-ends, HBT power amplifiers in phones, space solar cells
materials.logic_role: MESFET/HEMT direct-coupled FET logic (DCFL); Cray-3 supercomputer (1993) used GaAs logic

materials.name: Indium phosphide
materials.status: Fastest transistors (InP HEMT/HBT, sub-THz); lasers for optical links
materials.logic_role: Ultra-high-speed mixed-signal and SerDes; photonic integration

materials.name: Silicon carbide (4H)
materials.status: High-voltage power MOSFETs for EV traction inverters and chargers
materials.logic_role: High-temperature logic research (>500 °C JFET ICs); mainly power switching

materials.name: Gallium nitride
materials.status: Fast chargers, data-center power, 5G/radar HEMTs, blue/white LEDs
materials.logic_role: HEMT-based power ICs; GaN nMOS + Si pMOS 3D co-integration; p-GaN pFETs for GaN CMOS research

materials.name: Gallium oxide (β)
materials.status: Emerging kV power devices from melt-grown substrates
materials.logic_role: No practical p-type yet, so unipolar power devices

materials.name: Diamond
materials.status: H-terminated 2D-hole-gas FETs, boron-doped devices, heat spreaders, NV-center qubits
materials.logic_role: Complementary diamond inverters demonstrated; unmatched thermal conductivity for GaN-on-diamond

materials.name: Molybdenum disulfide (monolayer)
materials.status: 0.7 nm-thick channel; 5,900-transistor RISC-V (2025); 0.42 nm AlOx interface top-gate FETs (2026)
materials.logic_role: Candidate channel for beyond-silicon nanosheets and monolithic 3D logic
materials.note: mu_n: phonon-limited theory ~200-400; measured CVD films typically 10-100.

materials.name: Tungsten diselenide (monolayer)
materials.logic_role: Pairs with MoS2 for complementary 2D logic

materials.name: Carbon nanotube (semiconducting)
materials.logic_role: Ballistic 1D channels; purity and placement are the manufacturing hurdles

materials.name: Graphene
materials.status: No bandgap, so it cannot switch off for logic; used for RF, contacts, sensors
materials.logic_role: Interconnect and contact material research rather than switching channel
